page.layout: One printed page. Running head across the top, with the page number at the top right. Below it, a full-width emblem title. Then a woodcut picture (not text). Under the picture, one column of verse with a large initial letter, and a closing line of verse in italic. Signature at the bottom right.

main_text.head: Canis Lunam allatrans. XX.
main_text.p: LVna Selut toto collustrans lumine terras, Frustra allatrantes despicit alta canes: Sic quisquis Christum allatrat, Christisve ministros.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a dog barking at the moon, which shines over a landscape with hills, a town, a tree and a bush; it has no printed text. The large initial L is drawn as a decorative capital. The word "Selut" is printed as shown and may be a misprint for "Luna" or "Selene". The last line of verse is set in italic type.
